title: Listen and Choose a Response — Campus Life

questions.stem: Isn't the campus pool closed for cleaning this week?

options.A: Until Wednesday, so we can swim on Thursday.
options.B: I cleaned my room this week.
options.C: Yes, and it's open all week.
options.D: The pool is about fifty meters.

questions.explanation: This gives the reopening day and a plan. 'Yes, and it's open' contradicts itself; the others repeat 'cleaning' or describe the pool.
questions.speaker: f3

audioSegments.text: Isn't the campus pool closed for cleaning this week?
